periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis is oriented near-vertically with a slight medial tilt toward the inferior pole.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid morphology where the vertical length is approximately twice the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with a visible extension of the black patch below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick transverse band occupying approximately one-third of the visible lateral torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal gap between ears, roughly equivalent to the transverse width of the cranial vault.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded semicircular margins at the superior boundaries of both pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: The non-melanistic pelage exhibits a distinct yellowish-tan coloration throughout the cranial and dorsal regions.
